text: At Digit Gate IT, I went from Web Developer to Assistant Software Development Manager in under four years, and today lead the software department as Tech Lead. I lead a team of 10+ across 25+ web and 5+ mobile applications, run requirement analysis with clients, design system architecture for web and mobile projects, and manage our AWS infrastructure. I still write code when it matters. Some of the LMS and e-commerce platforms I lead have been live for more than five years, and our mobile apps are published on Google Play and the App Store.

I'm a Certified Trainer in Software Architecture, through a program supervised by TopSE at the National Institute of Informatics (NII), Japan. Good architecture is what separates software that lasts from software that breaks, and helping developers think that way is the part of my work I enjoy most.

Through msilabs, my open-source brand, I build and maintain bKash payment packages for Laravel and Node.js. They are free and open source (MIT), and the Laravel package has 2.9K+ installs on Packagist. I'm also co-founder of two software companies, Ihsan IT and Orbeetal, each run by its own dedicated team.
